findings.original_title: Organisation audit endpoint bypasses audit permission and project scope
findings.assessment: PR13 requires audit.read and returns metadata-only to full-tenant auditors; G03 probe G03 denies Site. PR16 still has org.read/raw audit. Integrate and test actual HTTP scope.

findings.original_title: Organisation dashboard fails against the migrated database
findings.assessment: PR13 dashboard executes on migrated DB in G04. Shared PR16 retains older query. Browser/metric acceptance remains separate.

findings.original_title: Profile PATCH breaks partial updates and cannot clear optional values
findings.assessment: PR13 typed PATCH preserves omitted fields and clears PAN in G01; stale-version parser tests pass. Integrate full consumer checks.

findings.original_title: Branding, state and retention inputs are not validated
findings.assessment: PR13 allowlist rejects invalid branding/state/retention in five parser tests and verifies logo metadata. Generated output, actual scanner/provider and legal retention remain separate.

findings.original_title: Required profile/default fields are silently ignored
findings.assessment: Contact/address/footer/logo fields now store/read (G11), but G02 proves self-approval policy divergence; defaults, multiple signatories and generated-output consumers remain incomplete.

findings.original_title: Offboarding accepts replacements without the required role or project access
findings.assessment: PR13 adds active identity/project/reviewer-role checks. Replacement membership locking, resource scope, stage/separation and allocation remain in PH2-G03-004.

findings.original_title: Self-replacement removes a member while leaving their open work assigned
findings.assessment: G05 rejects self replacement with SELF_REPLACEMENT_NOT_ALLOWED. Revalidate all aliases and integrated boundaries.

findings.original_title: Bulk reassignment mutates closed-project obligations without lifecycle locking
findings.assessment: G06 rejects already CLOSED; G08 closes during reassignment and then commits requirement changes. PH2-G03-003 remains open.

findings.original_title: Gap reports multiply reviews and infer roles from unrelated documents
findings.assessment: PR13 uses document-version/requirement joins and COUNT(DISTINCT rv.id). Fresh complex review/stage gap and integration regression remains required; full manifest is still incomplete.

findings.original_title: Bulk reassignment cannot safely handle PARTY review assignments
findings.assessment: PR13 blocks non-USER reviews instead of assigning a USER into PARTY authority. Legitimate delegated external transition is still missing; do not call this workflow complete.

findings.original_title: Offboarding gap omits pending submission responsibility
findings.assessment: PR13 blocks REMOVE on pending submissions, preserving history; public gap DTO omits them and no operational successor is supported.

findings.original_title: Organisation suspension blocks promised reads and exports
findings.assessment: PR13 blanket expiry and PR16 business denial/live ACTIVE fence still prevent the required suspended-org read/export contract.

findings.original_title: Emergency member suspension and reactivation lack a supported API workflow
findings.assessment: PR13 adds suspension and revocation; no supported reactivation/seat/assignment review flow or complete web journey.

findings.original_title: Ownership transfer completes without recipient confirmation
findings.assessment: G07 confirms one-sided ownership disabled. Two-party intent/confirm/cancel/expiry remains unimplemented.

findings.original_title: A globally suspended identity can become the sole organisation owner
findings.assessment: Disabled transfer prevents this transfer path in PR13; no completed eligible-owner recovery/global suspension policy is accepted.

findings.original_title: Seat limits are not enforced at invitation membership activation
findings.assessment: Primary P21 exceeds one seat. PR13 G10 blocks ACTIVE at limit, then PAST_DUE bypasses the same capacity. Effective entitlement/integration/concurrency remains open.

findings.original_title: Mobile member invitations promised by the contract are unsupported
findings.assessment: Issuer still accepts email only. Mobile destination/provider acceptance absent.

findings.original_title: Successful invitation issue/revocation leaves no business audit event
findings.assessment: G09 observes ORG_INVITATION_ISSUED/REVOKED with safe metadata in PR13. Delivery-state/acceptance correlation and integration still require regression.

findings.original_title: Organisation member identifiers reach SQL without runtime validation
findings.assessment: PR13 validates member/reassignment UUIDs at controller and uses profile allowlist. Real HTTP malformed-input matrix still required on integrated head.

findings.original_title: Resumable company onboarding is not implemented
findings.assessment: No persisted resumable four-step onboarding/required consent journey.

findings.original_title: Organisation administration has no application UI journey
findings.assessment: No complete org/team/settings/offboarding/ownership web administration journey.

findings.original_title: Owner-confirmed organisation deletion request workflow is missing
findings.assessment: No owner-name-confirmed staged org deletion request/status/cancel workflow.

findings.original_title: Offboarding and role-change transactions have an inverse lock order
findings.assessment: PR13 orders target session locks before target membership for role change/offboard. Not independently race-accepted with PR16 live authority locks; rerun deterministic multi-connection suite after integration.
